pages.title: 歌萊果
pages.text: $(bold)Biomes$(): $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#forest)Chorus Forest$(), $(l:the_moon/moon_biomes#thicket)Chorus Thicket$()$(br2)Chorus Plants grow in tall formations. Breaking the stem will yield nothing, while breaking the Flowers at the top will yield Chorus Fruits or a Flower.$(br)Chorus Fruits can be eaten for $(thing)Fruit$(), cooked and eaten as $(item)Popped Chorus Fruit$(), or can be distilled into $(thing)Nitrogen$().$(br)
$(thing)歌萊花$()也可以種在任何礫石或沙子上手動栽培。

pages.title: 歌萊產品
pages.text: 建立可再生的$(item)歌萊果$()來源，是在月球長期生存的關鍵。它們是$(item)氮$()唯一真正的來源，也可以蒸餾成生質以取得$(item)碳$()。
